headlines.title: Jeff Bezos says he was ‘heavily involved’ in picking the new James Bond
headlines.description: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos told an audience that he was “heavily involved” with casting Robert Pattinson to play the new James Bond, saying that he displayed “something special.”

headlines.title: Amid string of outages, bipartisan letter urges strategy to combat AI-assisted cyber threats
headlines.description: In the midst of a series of recent cyber outages, there is growing concern by members of Congress that the Trump administration needs to do more to protect infrastructure from cyberattacks that are aided by AI, according to a new bipartisan letter sent by two senators to the White House’s AI czar.

headlines.title: Nvidia enters the post-Jensen Huang era with a bang
headlines.description: Nvidia delivered a message with its first earnings report under new leadership: The sky isn’t falling.

headlines.title: Apple outages appear to be resolved after an internal update took popular services offline
headlines.description: Outages affecting several popular Apple services appeared to be resolved Tuesday night, after an internal update had taken them offline during the afternoon.

headlines.title: Nvidia board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang, chairman says
headlines.description: The Nvidia board "does not intend to reinstate" Jensen Huang as CEO, the newly appointed board chair, Harvey Jones, said on their quarterly earnings call. NBC News' Allie Canal and Sahil Kapur discuss how Nvidia topped estimates despite Huang's ouster.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang agrees to appear for House interview on Nvidia in December
headlines.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to appear before members of the House of Representatives from several committees for interviews about whether the company's sales to China may have endangered national security.

headlines.title: Home Heating Tips to Keep Costs Low This Winter
headlines.description: As winter weather arrives and temperatures drop, most Americans are cranking the heat. But, home heating bills could be higher than usual this year, with some monthly costs rising up to 7%. NBC’s Christine Romans joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to share ways you can bring down those expenses while keeping your home warm and cozy during the holidays.

headlines.title: Nationwide System Outages Impact Banks and Airlines
headlines.description: Banking and travel systems in the United States are coping with high-profile outages. Customers of Chase and other major banks were unable to access their money for hours on Monday due to a software bug. Meanwhile, a company-wide system outage forced United to cancel or delay flights across the country. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Sean Duffy’s $50B demand for air travel fixes is met with yelling and skepticism in Congress
headlines.description: The Trump administration’s request for $50.1 billion in new FAA funding after a nationwide ground stop is running into skepticism from both parties in Congress.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if asked to return as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: Jensen Huang said Tuesday that he would be “honored” to return to his job as CEO of Nvidia if the chip giant’s board of directors decided to bring him back.
